note: The facet vocabularies. Data, never enums in code (D40). Ids are append-only: a value that turns out wrong is superseded with `supersededBy`, never deleted and never re-used. Display names are free to change; ids are not. Spec: docs/TAXONOMY.md.

facets.name: Kind of record
facets.question: What kind of record is this?

values.name: Practice
values.note: You do it, it takes time, it can be checked off.

values.name: Measurement
values.note: Produces a number on a cadence. A tick box on a measurement is not a measurement.

values.name: Teaching
values.note: Connection cards, technique guides, awareness cues. Read, not done.

values.name: Intake
values.note: Supplements, food rules, hydration. Taken rather than performed.

values.name: Record
values.note: Labs, progress photos, journal entries. Captured rather than performed.

facets.name: What it does
facets.question: What does it do to the body?
facets.note: The coverage ledger counts in this vocabulary and the pairing law spends it, so every value here is a column in the ledger. The most expensive facet to change later — see TAXONOMY.md §11.1, still open.

values.name: Release
values.note: Lower resting tone or adhesion in a tissue.

values.name: Load
values.note: Load through a range. Law 1's other half.

values.name: Activate
values.note: Find and fire something that is offline. Not the same as loading it.

values.name: Condition
values.note: Provisional — TAXONOMY.md §11.1 asks whether this is in v1 at all.

facets.name: What it acts on
facets.question: What is it acting on?
facets.note: Where muscle-versus-fascia lives — as a property, never as a sub-category of effect. Dry needling is one item with three tissues.

facets.name: How it is done
facets.question: How is it done?
facets.note: Fourteen of these already ship on 77 items and render nowhere. Ids carry the tech- prefix they were authored with.

values.name: Dry needling
values.note: Not yet in the catalogue. Seeded because it is the case that proved tissue had to be multi-valued: release acting on muscle, fascia and nerve at once.

facets.name: Where you can do it
facets.question: Where can you do it?
facets.note: Already on 92 items with exactly these six values.

facets.name: What you need
facets.question: What does it need?
facets.note: Open. Today's `equipment` field is two vocabularies in one: 263 items carry short enum-ish values (bodyweight 94, band 24, dumbbell 20) and 71 carry prose ('A wall, plus a rolled hand towel...'). The prose is instruction and belongs in fields.tool; this facet is the filterable part. Kettlebell, mace and jump rope arrive here from `category`.

facets.name: What it occupies
facets.question: What does it need available?
facets.note: The item's half of the ordinary-moments match (TAXONOMY.md §6). An item's `demands` are what it needs available; an opportunity's `occupies` are what that moment makes UNAVAILABLE, drawn from this same vocabulary. An item fits when the two sets do not intersect. Closed, because opportunities.json is validated against it.

values.name: Both hands
values.note: Needs two free hands. A moment that takes even one hand occupies this, which is why every moment occupying `one-hand` must occupy `hands` too — the checker refuses the other way round.

values.name: One free hand
values.note: Needs one free hand. Only a moment that takes BOTH hands occupies this — brushing your teeth leaves a hand, so it blocks `hands` and not `one-hand`.

values.name: Your attention
values.note: Cannot be done while holding a conversation or following something.

facets.name: Who does it
facets.question: Who performs it?
facets.note: Separates 'what can I do tonight' from 'what should I book'. Cupping, acupuncture and needling are currently indistinguishable in the data from a hamstring stretch.

facets.name: Where it comes from
facets.question: What tradition is it from?
facets.note: A label, never a shelf — so anything from any school enters as `load` and still says where it came from. `martial_arts` and `athletic` arrive here from `category`.

facets.name: How well established
facets.question: How well established is it?
facets.note: Ships and renders today, on 118 items. Listed here so the vocabulary lives in one place, not to change it.
